chapter: Favorite horn players and the Picou job
title: Favorite trumpet players
summary: He praises Kid Rena, Celestin, Manuel Perez, Euless Jean, Chris Kelly, Sam Morgan and his brother, a sweet waltz player.

story.theme_name: Remembering the early trumpeters and their styles
story.community_name: Trumpeters I admired: rating the horn players

blocks.x: Are there any other favorite musicians you had? Who was the best trumpet players in the old days that you liked to hear or play with?
I used to like to hear Renee, I used to like to hear Celestan, Randy Perez during his time when he was living. And Euless Jean was good and Chris Kelly and Sam Morgan and Albert Snighy.
And my brother was a pretty good trumpet player. Yeah, he was a sweet waltz player. You couldn't find a man who played better trumpet than him. And he just takes six, taking six years.
